title: kate-ui: underline diagnostics, list them, and show hover
summary: The editor paints a wavy underline under each diagnostics::Underline in the severity color. A bottom pane lists diagnostic_rows; a click moves the caret to that line. When the mouse rests over the text for half a second, the window requests hover and shows hover_text in a popup near the pointer.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Store the anchored diagnostics per document from the Diagnostics events. paint.rs gets a wavy underline step per Underline below the text baseline in red for Error, orange for Warning, and the comment color otherwise. cmd-shift-m toggles the pane; each row shows diagnostic_pane_line; a click runs MoveTo at that line and column. On mouse rest the window sends hover_params for the position under the pointer and shows hover_text of the Response in a popup that closes on mouse move. diagnostic_pane_line writes line + 1, a colon, col + 1, a space, the severity word, a space, and the message. The test diagnostic_pane_line_formats_the_row asserts a row at line 0 col 1 Warning fake gives 1:2 Warning fake. The owner sees the underline from the fake diagnostic in a test run or from rust-analyzer. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it.
